spans.s: ऐरावण, i. e. इरावन् + अ (the base is curtailed इरावन्त्, ved., and cf. इरावती), m. Indra's elephant,

ऐरावत, i. e. इरावन्त् + अ (see the last),
 I. m.
 1. Indra's elephant, considered as the elephant of the east quarter,
. A patronymic name of a Nāga,
. The name of the northern path of the moon,

.
 II. m. and n. A particular shape of the rainbow,

.
 III. m., f. ती, and n. Lightning,

.
 IV. m. The orange-tree; n. its fruit,

.
 V. f. ती, The name of a river,
